<!-- ===================== INSTALL ===================== -->
<section class="band install-band">
  <div class="install">
    <div class="install-bar">
      <div class="tl"><span></span><span></span><span></span></div>
      <span class="label">Console · R</span>
    </div>
    <div class="install-body">
      <div class="copy-row">
        <div>
          <div class="code-line"><span class="pr">&gt;</span><span><span class="fn">pak::pak</span>(<span class="str">"rogerio-onza/saira"</span>)</span></div>
          <div class="code-line"><span class="pr">&gt;</span><span><span class="fn">saira::run_app</span>()</span></div>

        <button class="copy-btn" data-copy='pak::pak("rogerio-onza/saira")&#10;saira::run_app()'>

<!-- ===================== WHAT IT IS ===================== -->
<section class="band" id="project">
  <div class="wrap">
    <div class="about-grid">
      <div class="about-text">
        <span class="eyebrow">What it is</span>
        <p class="lead">Saíra takes you from the field notebook to the global repository — turning heterogeneous spreadsheets into <em>clean, validated and interoperable</em> records.</p>
        <p>Scientific collections hold decades of knowledge about biodiversity, but their data rarely speak the same language. Saíra offers a guided, visual and bilingual workflow (PT-BR/EN) to map your fields to the Darwin Core standard, detect inconsistencies and export a publication-ready package.</p>
        <p>Built in R and Shiny, it runs on your own computer or an institutional server. No mandatory command line, no black box: every transformation decision is recorded and reproducible.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="about-media">
        <figure class="shot" style="margin:0">
          <div class="frame"><span class="ph-label">illustration · coming soon</span></div>
        </figure>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<!-- ===================== FEATURES ===================== -->
<section class="band" id="features" style="padding-top:0">
  <div class="wrap">
    <div class="section-head center">
      <span class="eyebrow">Features</span>
      <h2>One workflow, from raw data to DwC-A</h2>
      <p>Steps designed for curators and field researchers — not for programmers.</p>
    </div>
    <ol class="feature-list">
      <li class="feature">
        <span class="num">01</span>
        <div class="ic"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8"><path d="M21 15v4a2 2 0 01-2 2H5a2 2 0 01-2-2v-4"/><path d="M7 10l5 5 5-5M12 15V3"/></svg></div>
        <div class="feature-body">
          <h3>Import</h3>
          <p>Load CSV or Excel spreadsheets — including camera-trap data — with encoding and separator detection.</p>
        </div>
      </li>
      <li class="feature">
        <span class="num">02</span>
        <div class="ic"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8"><path d="M3 6h7M14 6h7M3 12h4M11 12h10M3 18h7M14 18h7"/><circle cx="11" cy="6" r="1.5" fill="currentColor"/><circle cx="8" cy="12" r="1.5" fill="currentColor"/><circle cx="11" cy="18" r="1.5" fill="currentColor"/></svg></div>
        <div class="feature-body">
          <h3>Field mapping</h3>
          <p>Match your spreadsheet columns to Darwin Core terms with automatic suggestions and reusable templates.</p>
        </div>
      </li>
      <li class="feature">
        <span class="num">03</span>
        <div class="ic"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8"><circle cx="6" cy="6" r="2.5"/><circle cx="18" cy="6" r="2.5"/><circle cx="12" cy="18" r="2.5"/><path d="M6 8.5v3a2 2 0 002 2h8a2 2 0 002-2v-3M12 13.5v2"/></svg></div>
        <div class="feature-body">
          <h3>Taxonomic harmonization</h3>
          <p>Check scientific names against taxonomic backbones and resolve synonyms and spelling variants.</p>
        </div>
      </li>
      <li class="feature">
        <span class="num">04</span>
        <div class="ic"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8"><path d="M12 21s-7-5.5-7-11a7 7 0 0114 0c0 5.5-7 11-7 11z"/><circle cx="12" cy="10" r="2.5"/></svg></div>
        <div class="feature-body">
          <h3>Coordinate validation</h3>
          <p>Detect missing, swapped or land/sea-incompatible coordinates, with visual review on the map.</p>
        </div>
      </li>
      <li class="feature">
        <span class="num">05</span>
        <div class="ic"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8"><path d="M9 12l2 2 4-4"/><path d="M12 3l8 4.5v9L12 21l-8-4.5v-9L12 3z"/></svg></div>
        <div class="feature-body">
          <h3>Sensitive species</h3>
          <p>Flag threatened taxa (national list) for sensitive-data handling before publication.</p>
        </div>
      </li>
      <li class="feature">
        <span class="num">06</span>
        <div class="ic"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8"><path d="M14 2H6a2 2 0 00-2 2v16a2 2 0 002 2h12a2 2 0 002-2V8l-6-6z"/><path d="M14 2v6h6M8 13h8M8 17h5"/></svg></div>
        <div class="feature-body">
          <h3>DwC-A export</h3>
          <p>Generate the complete Darwin Core Archive — <span class="term">occurrence.txt</span>, <span class="term">meta.xml</span> and <span class="term">eml.xml</span> — ready for GBIF and SiBBr.</p>
        </div>
      </li>
    </ol>
  </div>
</section>

<!-- ===================== WHY DARWIN CORE ===================== -->
<section class="band band-alt">
  <div class="wrap">
    <div class="dwc-grid">
      <div class="dwc-text">
        <span class="eyebrow">Why Darwin Core?</span>
        <h2>A common language for life</h2>
        <p class="lead">Darwin Core is the TDWG standard that describes occurrences of organisms in time and space.</p>
        <p>By speaking Darwin Core, your collection becomes discoverable and combinable with millions of records from GBIF, SiBBr and SpeciesLink. Each term has a stable definition — which makes the data useful far beyond your own institution.</p>
        <div class="dwc-chips">
          <span class="chip">occurrenceID</span>
          <span class="chip">scientificName</span>
          <span class="chip">decimalLatitude</span>
          <span class="chip">eventDate</span>
          <span class="chip">basisOfRecord</span>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="record">
        <div class="install-bar">
          <div class="tl"><span></span><span></span><span></span></div>
          <span class="label">occurrence · record</span>
        </div>
        <pre><span class="p">{</span>
  <span class="k">"occurrenceID"</span>: <span class="s">"SAIRA:MN:0042817"</span>,
  <span class="k">"basisOfRecord"</span>: <span class="s">"PreservedSpecimen"</span>,
  <span class="k">"scientificName"</span>: <span class="s">"Tangara fastuosa"</span>,
  <span class="k">"kingdom"</span>: <span class="s">"Animalia"</span>,
  <span class="k">"family"</span>: <span class="s">"Thraupidae"</span>,
  <span class="k">"decimalLatitude"</span>: <span class="n">-8.0476</span>,
  <span class="k">"decimalLongitude"</span>: <span class="n">-34.8770</span>,
  <span class="k">"geodeticDatum"</span>: <span class="s">"WGS84"</span>,
  <span class="k">"eventDate"</span>: <span class="s">"2024-11-03"</span>,
  <span class="k">"country"</span>: <span class="s">"Brazil"</span>,
  <span class="k">"stateProvince"</span>: <span class="s">"Pernambuco"</span>,
  <span class="k">"recordedBy"</span>: <span class="s">"M. Andrade"</span>
<span class="p">}</span></pre>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<script>
/* copy button for the install block */
document.querySelectorAll('[data-copy]').forEach(function (btn) {
  btn.addEventListener('click', function () {
    var text = btn.getAttribute('data-copy');
    var label = btn.querySelector('.ct');
    function flash() {
      btn.classList.add('copied');
      if (label) label.textContent = 'Copied!';
      setTimeout(function () { btn.classList.remove('copied'); if (label) label.textContent = 'Copy'; }, 1600);
    }
    if (navigator.clipboard) { navigator.clipboard.writeText(text).then(flash, flash); }
    else { flash(); }
  });
});
</script>
<script src="../assets/js/hero-network.js" defer></script>
